## 中文

`v0.8.0` 适配 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.1` 的 Web Profile。新版 DSH 拆分了客户端运行模块，并调整了模型目录和选择接口；旧版插件因此可能被兼容性检查跳过。

### 更新内容

- 更新客户端依赖与类型，使用新版模型目录状态和槽位渲染模块。
- 模型或推理强度选择失败时读取新版返回结果，恢复之前的选择，不再把失败视为成功。
- 此版本面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`；使用 DSH `0.1.x` 请保留 [v0.7.3](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/releases/tag/v0.7.3)。

### 安装或更新

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#v0.8.0
```

安装后重启 DSH Web Host 并刷新页面。附件 `dsh-reasoning-effort-0.8.0.tgz` 为本版本插件包。

## English

`v0.8.0` adapts the plugin to the DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.1` Web Profile. DSH split its client runtime modules and changed the model directory and selection APIs, so it may skip older plugin builds during compatibility checks.

### Changes

- Update client dependencies and types for the new model directory state and slot renderer.
- Read the new selection result and restore the previous model or effort when a request fails.
- This release targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`; users on DSH `0.1.x` should stay on [v0.7.3](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/releases/tag/v0.7.3).

### Install or update

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#v0.8.0
```

Restart the DSH Web Host and refresh the page after installation. The attached `dsh-reasoning-effort-0.8.0.tgz` is the package for this release.
